about: [C1] Going down through the kit (game.fail): IV The Door and VIII The Block share the Game's fall now (their own retries kept: IV's door already shut, VIII's dead of the beats before); health reaching zero in a scene with neither (the kit's test bed) uses the default. Health is taken by a debug hook (G.health.damage), the rest is the game's. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/kit_downs.json

steps.name: IV The Door: down, back at the shadows

steps.expect: G.lastFail.why === 'They got you.' && G.lastFail.fall === true && G.lastFail.to === 'shadows'
steps.label: IV: down is the kit's fall, 'They got you.', back to the shadows

steps.expect: performance.now() - window.__t0 < 10000 && G.scenes.current.id === 'gunfight' && G.scenes.beat === 'shadows' && G.health.hp === 100 && !G.controller.frozen && G.controller.mode === 'office'
steps.label: IV: up at the shadows with control, under ten seconds
IV: its own retry kept: the revolver out, the door already shut

steps.name: VIII The Block: down in the doorways, back at the doorways

steps.label: VIII: down is the kit's fall, back to the doorways

steps.expect: performance.now() - window.__t0 < 10000 && G.scenes.beat === 'doorways' && G.health.hp === 100 && !G.controller.frozen && G.b7 && G.b7.downs && G.b7.downs.doorways === 1
steps.label: VIII: up in the doorways with control, its mercy counting the down

steps.name: the test bed: no onDown, no checkpoint: the default

steps.label: health at zero with nothing declared: 'Down.' at the beat
game.setCheckpoint's words when there is no onDown
never THE END card in the story
